cand.moveAlignsWithRetreat.source: observed actor cell + live RETREAT parameters + declared deltas (P.1A contract field)

cand.moveOpposesRetreat.source: observed actor cell + live RETREAT parameters + declared deltas (P.1A contract field)

cand.moveWithHostileGeometry.source: a legal RETREAT exists (hostile geometry partially revealed), on MOVE candidates

cand.reverseMoveLegal.source: live legal MOVE directions (relative: the opposite MOVE is legal)

cand.perpendicularMovesLegal.source: live legal MOVE directions (relative: count of legal perpendicular MOVEs, 0-2)

geom.deltaCentreDistance.source: observed actor cell + declared gridSize(scenarioLevel) + declared deltas

geom.destinationOnBorder.source: observed actor cell + declared gridSize(scenarioLevel) + declared deltas

geom.deltaBorderDistance.source: observed actor cell + declared gridSize(scenarioLevel) + declared deltas

diag.absoluteDirection.source: MOVE parameters.direction in the presented frame; changes under every non-identity D4 transform

diag.actionIdentityRank.source: rank of the action identity (forgeActionKey); used only by the LOWEST/HIGHEST_ID controls

diag.canonicalFrameDirection.source: direction in the canonical frame, which minimises a digest of the FULL kernel geometry (privileged positions)

diag.hiddenOrientationDirection.source: direction in the generator base frame, i.e. the hidden benchmark orientation label

diag.privilegedRelations.source: kernel entity positions (objective, material, resources, hostiles, threatened, critical, hubs); not exposed by the live interfaces

diag.oneStepImmediate.source: immediateScalar of the simulated successor state

diag.horizonTotal.source: totalScalar of the horizon rollout; determines regret exactly, so also LEAKED; never a column

row.materialDirection.source: kernel material position relative to the actor; never a column

calSelection.rule: the headline STATE+CANDIDATE model is the SC_* variant with the highest CAL top-1 accuracy; ties within 1e-9 -> fewer columns

disclosures.LEVEL_COVERAGE: canonical admission order: FRESH_HOLDOUT covers the low curriculum levels in data.fresh.levels; DEV/CAL cover levels 0-1
disclosures.TSYM_PARTITIONS: SECONDARY replication: the Stage 3F.6-T-SYM fresh HOLDOUT (seed 2022); policy-level outcomes were evaluated there, candidate models never
disclosures.STATE_ONLY_DEFINITION: STATE_ONLY: candidate identity is reduced to its declared type (the minimum that names a candidate); every MOVE is identical, so it chooses uniformly among MOVEs
disclosures.NO_ABSTENTION: no scorer abstains; abstention is not measured
